description: AI infrastructure provider whose public Serverless Inference offering is delivered through W&B Inference.

sources.notes: CoreWeave states that Serverless Inference is delivered through W&B Inference and that W&B owns the canonical setup, usage, model, and reference documentation.
CoreWeave distinguishes pay-per-token Serverless Inference from GPU-hour Dedicated Inference; the public serverless API and token pricing surface is W&B Inference.

verification.notes: Verified that CoreWeave does not document a separate public first-party serverless model API. Public Serverless Inference is exposed through W&B Inference, which is catalogued under the weights-and-biases provider.
